note: Cross-discipline routing contract for the seven-skill catalog. Each case is a realistic request and the discipline that should own it; the set preserves representative intents from the pre-consolidation catalog after the old slugs were removed. Owner 'none' marks a control that should not activate a discipline.

cases.name: prioritize-release-scope
cases.prompt: We have three competing feature requests and no clear priority. Decide what goes into the next release and what explicitly does not.

cases.name: model-onboarding-experience
cases.prompt: Turn these behavioral findings into an object model, the key flows, an information architecture, and a prototype plan for onboarding.

cases.name: select-generated-design-direction
cases.prompt: AI generated twelve polished onboarding directions. Compare materially different options on the same realistic slice, choose one coherent direction, and remove details that do not serve the intended qualities.

cases.name: design-churn-interview-program
cases.prompt: Design a churn interview program: recruit ten departed customers, write the protocol, and synthesize the findings into Jobs to Be Done.

cases.name: name-a-feature-bilingually
cases.prompt: We need a name for this feature that works in German and English and is still spellable after somebody hears it once.

cases.name: replace-gamed-seat-pricing
cases.prompt: Customers are gaming our per-seat pricing. Give me two or three value metrics with realistic billing scenarios and a migration path.

cases.name: record-durable-decision
cases.prompt: Record why we chose usage-based pricing over seats, which options we rejected, and what would reopen the decision.

cases.name: record-intuition-without-promoting-it
cases.prompt: Our experienced founder's intuition conflicts with the explicit evidence for this hard-to-reverse platform choice. Record the durable decision without erasing either input or pretending intuition is proof.

cases.name: fix-dashboard-accessibility
cases.prompt: Audit this dashboard for accessibility and responsive problems, fix the highest-impact ones, and verify the result in the browser.

cases.name: specify-reference-motion
cases.prompt: Reverse-engineer the scroll motion and responsive behavior of this reference site into a specification we can implement.

cases.name: audit-page-against-references
cases.prompt: Our new landing page is finished. Check it against the reference sites we drew from and tell me whether anything is too close.

cases.name: scope-jurisdiction-disclosures
cases.prompt: We sell to Germany and California. Which operator disclosures, privacy notices, and consent requirements apply to our site?

cases.name: scope-marketing-endorsement-disclosures
cases.prompt: Audit the testimonials, affiliate links, influencer endorsements, and marketing claims on this website and identify the disclosures the browser experience needs.

cases.name: decide-service-boundary
cases.prompt: Should billing stay inside the monolith or become its own service? Argue from our actual load, ownership, and failure consequences.

cases.name: choose-strategic-control-boundary
cases.prompt: Decide whether this mission-critical billing capability should be built in-house, based on open source, bought as a managed service, or vertically integrated. Identify what we actually need to control and the exit path.

cases.name: fix-conflicting-status-writes
cases.prompt: Two services write the same order status and customers sometimes see it move backwards. Decide the ownership and consistency contract.

cases.name: replace-unsound-type-cast
cases.prompt: This `as unknown as T` cast is holding a boundary together. Replace it with a narrowing that actually proves the type, or tell me why it cannot be done.

cases.name: review-rust-public-api
cases.prompt: Review this crate's public API before 1.0. I care about lifetimes leaking internals and panic paths I have not documented.

cases.name: design-public-api-contract
cases.prompt: Our warehouse service exposes an API to checkout, support tooling, and a partner. Define the request, outcome, error, retry, and compatibility contract without assuming a transport or versioning style.

cases.name: write-discriminating-regression-test
cases.prompt: Add a regression test for this bug fix and show me that it actually fails against the old behavior.

cases.name: coordinate-vague-bug-report
cases.prompt: Take this vague bug report through diagnosis, an authorized fix, focused verification, and a review-ready handoff.

cases.name: coordinate-ai-generated-production-code
cases.prompt: Have agents implement this high-impact production change, but keep architecture, data, security, compatibility, and acceptance decisions accountable and verify the generated result independently.

cases.name: rank-repository-improvements
cases.prompt: Audit this repository and rank the five highest-leverage improvements with the evidence for each.

cases.name: diagnose-repeated-agent-divergence
cases.prompt: Three capable agents implemented the same authorization rule differently. Diagnose which repository contract, example, ownership boundary, decision, or test is missing before changing the prompt.

cases.name: port-library-preserving-behavior
cases.prompt: Rewrite this C library in Rust while preserving its public API and error semantics, and prove nothing changed behaviorally.

cases.name: work-the-review-queue
cases.prompt: Catch up on my review queue: check the open pull requests, decide what is merge-ready, and leave the reviews.

cases.name: prepare-dependency-portfolio
cases.prompt: Research our outdated packages, group the compatible upgrades, and prepare focused dependency pull requests.

cases.name: run-established-checks
cases.prompt: Run this repository's existing typecheck, lint, and test commands against my branch and report exactly what passed or failed.

cases.name: write-migration-notes
cases.prompt: Write the migration notes for this breaking API change, derived from the actual implementation and tests rather than the changelog.

cases.name: diagnose-deploy-ownership
cases.prompt: Two teams both think they own deploys and nothing ships on Fridays. Diagnose the system before proposing a reorganization.

cases.name: operate-unspecified-issue-queue
cases.prompt: Work through my unassigned issue queue one item at a time, keep the resulting pull requests review-ready, and do not merge them.

cases.name: draft-article-from-notes
cases.prompt: Turn these workshop notes into a 1,500-word article for product leaders. Make a clear argument and preserve my direct voice.

cases.name: pressure-test-minto-pyramid
cases.prompt: Minto this board memo before rewriting it: identify the reader's question and governing answer, then pressure-test every supporting group for MECE and logical order.

cases.name: audit-formulaic-prose
cases.prompt: Audit this draft for formulaic, AI-sounding patterns. Quote the evidence, do not rewrite it, and do not guess who wrote it.

cases.name: humanize-team-update
cases.prompt: Rewrite this stiff German status note as a Slack update that sounds like a teammate wrote it, not a press release.

cases.name: correct-german-typography
cases.prompt: Our German interface strings use straight quotes and English dash spacing. Correct the typography to match de-DE conventions without touching the keys.

cases.name: choose-segment-and-position
cases.prompt: Choose our target segment and category position from this evidence, then build the message hierarchy and name the proof gaps.

cases.name: select-distribution-motion
cases.prompt: Choose whether this offer needs founder-led sales, partners, content, paid acquisition, product-led growth, or high-touch delivery from its economics, trust, support load, and access advantages. Diagnose whether more feature work is avoiding the distribution constraint.

cases.name: write-homepage-hero
cases.prompt: Write a homepage hero headline, subheadline, and primary call to action from our approved positioning and proof pack.

cases.name: diagnose-checkout-dropoff
cases.prompt: Signup drops 60% between the plan page and checkout. Diagnose it before proposing a test, and tell me if this is even an A/B test question.

cases.name: adapt-writeup-for-social
cases.prompt: Turn this migration write-up into posts for Mastodon and Bluesky without letting the social version claim more than the source supports.

cases.name: plan-evidence-led-x-strategy
cases.prompt: Build a starting X content strategy from our audience, product evidence, founder voice, and account analytics, then separate durable guidance from current platform hypotheses.

cases.name: write-single-linkedin-post
cases.prompt: Write one LinkedIn post from these migration lessons for an engineering-leadership audience.

cases.name: build-linkedin-pipeline
cases.prompt: Build a LinkedIn acquisition system connecting positioning, profile, target accounts, outreach conversations, and qualified meetings.

cases.name: audit-consultant-profile
cases.prompt: Audit my consultant CV. What is my professional thesis, which projects should be signature, and what evidence is still missing?

cases.name: boundary-research-versus-messaging
cases.prompt: Interview our lost deals about why they chose a competitor and synthesize what we learn.

cases.name: boundary-test-design-versus-check-execution
cases.prompt: Make sure this authorization rule is covered. Write the focused test that protects it.

cases.name: boundary-pr-review-versus-api-review
cases.prompt: Review pull request 184 and decide whether it is safe to merge.

cases.name: boundary-browser-api-versus-service-contract
cases.prompt: Design the browser-side data contract and loading states for this React checkout page, including how the UI handles a failed request.

cases.name: boundary-editorial-versus-commercial-prose
cases.prompt: Write a long-form essay explaining the architectural bet behind our new release for a technical audience.

cases.name: control-general-knowledge
cases.prompt: Explain the difference between TCP and UDP.

cases.name: control-spreadsheet-task
cases.prompt: Convert this CSV of sales figures into a pivot table and tell me which region grew fastest.

cases.name: control-scheduling
cases.prompt: What time is it in Tokyo right now, and is that a reasonable hour to call?

cases.name: write-cold-outreach
cases.prompt: Research prospects for our accounting service and write a cold email and a phone guide that respect the contact rules in Germany.

cases.name: run-consultative-sales
cases.prompt: Prepare a qualification guide, a consultation arc, and objection handling for our IT retainer sales calls.

cases.name: design-crm-pipeline
cases.prompt: Design our CRM pipeline stages with entry rules, saved views, and an automation for new website inquiries.

cases.name: price-service-engagement
cases.prompt: Work out a price floor and payment structure for our fixed-scope website relaunch service before we quote it.

cases.name: build-webhook-idempotency
cases.prompt: Implement idempotent webhook handling with an event-ID table in our own Node service so replayed deliveries never create duplicate orders.

cases.name: cross-channel-content-portfolio
cases.prompt: Plan a content portfolio and production priorities for our B2B software across search, newsletters, and social channels.

cases.name: search-query-topic-clusters
cases.prompt: Group our keyword export by audience intent, identify gaps and overlaps with existing content, and propose topics to commission.

cases.name: dated-competitive-profiles
cases.prompt: Research comparable dated profiles of three competitors with plan terms, capabilities, evidence sources, and unknowns.

cases.name: commercial-alternatives-page
cases.prompt: Draft a buyer-facing alternatives-to-Acme page from our approved positioning and competitor facts.

cases.name: software-acquisition-options
cases.prompt: Suggest feasible acquisition tests for our software using templates, partnerships, or useful tools, with effort and learning criteria.

cases.name: commercial-content-refresh
cases.prompt: Refresh our landing page against approved current plan terms and proof; identify unsupported claims and give revised copy.

cases.name: editorial-content-refresh
cases.prompt: Refresh an informative newsletter essay with current examples and a clearer argument. It has no offer or sales call to action.

cases.name: retouch-business-portraits
cases.prompt: Retouch these business portraits with smoother shirt sleeves, clearer glasses, and natural skin. Keep the people and the original shoot setting.

cases.name: match-approved-photo-series
cases.prompt: Apply the approved warm portrait treatment across the remaining shoot while preserving each pose, expression, and indoor or outdoor lighting.

cases.name: refine-existing-photo-edit
cases.prompt: Refine this previously approved portrait using the original as an identity reference. Preserve the current color treatment and quiet sideways gaze.

cases.name: mark-visual-changes-in-pr
cases.prompt: Show reviewers what this pull request changes on the site: before/after screenshots of the affected pages with the changed areas marked.
